outdoor_uncovered.basis: Toyobo HM outdoor points at Ohtsu, June-November 1997; 45 degrees south.
outdoor_uncovered.formula: log-linear 1 to .71 over first half month; then exp[ln(.35)*(years/.5)^beta]
outdoor_uncovered.transfer: No source spectral dose, weather history or grade/laminate equivalence. No air barrier in this counterfactual.

light_blocked_humid_40C80RH_proxy.basis: Toyobo AS 555 dtex, dark 40 C/80% RH; manual figure readings through 1000 days.
light_blocked_humid_40C80RH_proxy.formula: piecewise log interpolation through 1000 days, then exp[ln(.76)*(days/1000)^beta]
light_blocked_humid_40C80RH_proxy.transfer: AS-to-HM and continuous 40 C/80% RH are comparison proxies, not the declared year's kinetics.

light_blocked_warehouse_endpoint_exponen.basis: Toyobo AS warehouse curve about .96 at 1000 days.
light_blocked_warehouse_endpoint_exponen.transfer: Endpoint-only constant-rate assumption does not reproduce the early knee; warehouse humidity/temperature unspecified in this source.

sealed_argon_55C_loss_ceiling_extrapolat.basis: NISTIR7373: <4% loss in sealed argon-filled glass tubes at 55 C over 210 days.
sealed_argon_55C_loss_ceiling_extrapolat.transfer: Repeated worst observed loss is a sensitivity, not a fitted trend or proof of polymer-laminate protection.

dry_protection_acceptance_target.classification: PROJECTION / REQUIREMENT, NOT A MEASURED RATE
dry_protection_acceptance_target.basis: Chosen maximum combined irreversible loss budget 0.5% annually.
dry_protection_acceptance_target.transfer: Must be demonstrated on loaded finished laminate including seams, light, moisture, creep and cycling.
